cover.headline: The merch line, decoded
cover.sub: What a label means when it offers to run your merch, and how to keep the margin.

blocks.text: In a 360 or merch deal, **merch rights** can sit inside the contract. The label sells your designs and pays you a share.
Read the merch clause before you sign: the share, the term and who owns the designs.
Example hoodie sold in your own store.
Run merch through a store you own, so every order adds a buyer to your list.
A shirt plus the record is an easy upgrade for a fan who was **already buying**.
Offer one bundle per release. Three options max, or people stall.

slides.headline: The buyer list is the asset

blocks.text: Every order gives you a name, an email and a city. In a label-run store, that list isn't yours.
Tag every merch buyer in your email tool so the next drop goes to them first.
